waypoints.name: Col de la Bonette
waypoints.advice: Col de la Bonette, about halfway at 2715 m. The road climbs 607 m on the way up to it, steadily. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Col de Turini, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Col de Turini
waypoints.advice: Col de Turini sits at 378 km, late in the day. You lose 1108 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Menton, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Menton

sections.advice: Col du Galibier → Col d Izoard is 45 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Col d Izoard → Col de Vars is 38 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Col de Vars → Col de la Bonette climbs about 607 m in 34 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Col de la Bonette → Col de Turini drops about 1108 m over 78 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Col de Turini → Menton drops about 1607 m over 28 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Col d Izoard → Col de Vars
scenicChapters.narrative: 81 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 71 km. 607 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1607 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

route-des-grandes-alpes-col-du-galibier-.story: 473 km one way from Valloire - plan on about 7 h 55 of riding. The stops in between: Col d Izoard, Col de Vars, Col de la Bonette and Col de Turini. The highest point is about 2,700 m. Col du Galibier, Col d Izoard, Col de Vars, Col de Restefond and Col de Turini are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
